note: Defaults for each role. Override any of them in ~/.config/agent-executor/config.json (run_agent.py init writes a starter). Claude, GPT and Gemini always run in their own harness; opencode routes are for families without one (GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi). Models are family selectors (see families.json) that resolve to the newest live ID; write an exact ID to pin one.
